claim_boundary: A SAT model would be a valid (5,5;43) graph after independent full-graph verification and would prove R(5,5) >= 44. A checked UNSAT proof excludes only undirected circulant graphs on Z_43; it is not global order-43 nonexistence.
cnf_reduction: Enumerate every 5-subset of Z_43, replace its ten pairs by the set of distinct undirected circular distances, deduplicate identical distance signatures, and emit one all-positive and one all-negative clause per signature.
hypothesis: The known near-cyclic order-42 construction does not extend to a fully translation-invariant order-43 coloring; the complete 21-variable circulant class is UNSAT.
proof_requirements: Independent clause-by-clause reconstruction must match the exact generated CNF.
For UNSAT, drat-trim must validate the Glucose DRAT and emit LRAT.
lrat-check must validate the LRAT against the independently matched CNF.
For SAT, decode every distance variable, materialize all 903 graph edges, and run both established full-graph verifiers before making any construction claim.

storage_gate.on_failure: Do not launch; retain the frozen plan unchanged.

variable_semantics: For d in {1,...,21}, variable d is true exactly when every pair {u,v} with min((u-v) mod 43,(v-u) mod 43)=d is a graph edge.
